# `SearchReport`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\SearchReport`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/SearchReport.php#L17) — **Version:** working tree

What the targeted search of a run amounted to, as data: how many bodies
the search phase executed and where every label ended up. Built once,
when the run finishes, and carried on [`Event\PropertyFinished`](/api/classes/Event/PropertyFinished)
beside the DistributionReport — only for a run that targeted
something, so a property that never calls
[`Target`](/api/classes/Target) pays nothing and sees nothing.

## Constructor

```php
__construct(
    int $evaluations,
    array<string,\Runner\TargetOutcome> $targets,
)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$evaluations` | `int` | *required* | Bodies executed in the search phase (the random phase's are in the distribution report). |
| `$targets` | `array<string,\Runner\TargetOutcome>` | *required* | By label, in the order the labels were first reported. |
